chairman.title: Message from the Chairman's Desk
chairman.author: IBUNU SUWOOTHU KAMAL
chairman.roleSubtitle: Founder & Principal Strategist • Best Star Group FZE
chairman.quote: Safety, Service, and Quality are the cornerstones on which we have traversed our journey to growth and that alone sets us apart.
chairman.leadParagraph: At Best Star Group, We believe that success comes from relentless focus on shared vision, innovation and execution. Our recent decision to become a holding company is the need of the hour and this has laid the foundation for its Global structure. We have started becoming globally visible with the experience and knowledge we have gathered from our domestic companies.
chairman.paragraph1: With a humble beginning in Tourism we have evolved rapidly and today our nine proud verticals in diversified fields in UAE alone demonstrates a crucial transition and we have left behind one mile stone after the other in our smart journey spanning over a period of eight years.
chairman.paragraph2: Our success lies in our diversity which contributes immensely to the growth of our group. On one hand our diversity and on the other hand our Group’s entrepreneurial spirit has led to its sustained success over the years. Our entrepreneurial instincts has enabled us to make inroads into Malaysia with highly performing restaurants, supermarkets and latest generation mobile accessories setup.
chairman.paragraph3: The latest feather in our cap is the Moon TV channel beaming from the Indian Sub continent where in we have a significant stake.
chairman.paragraph4: The world has suddenly shrunk and thus any business aiming to become big has to think in global terms, as the competition is no longer confined to the domestic frontiers.
chairman.paragraph5: Best Star Group FZE is no different from others in identifying this business compulsion and has quickly aligned itself to the same.
chairman.paragraph6: When I speak about innovation and execution, we gravitate around getting the right things, right people at the right time and the right cost structure. This applies to both our business and sustainability.
chairman.paragraph7: Safety, Service and Quality are the corner stones on which we have traversed our journey to growth and that alone sets us apart.
chairman.paragraph8: We look forward to continuing to innovate and execute, identify promising entrepreneurial skills to become partners with us while focusing on making our work place and stake holders more attractive, supportive and inclusive.

subsidiaries.title: Our Diversified Enterprise Portfolio

pharma.name: Best Star Pharma Trading L.L.C
pharma.description: Leading pharmaceutical distributor and retail pharmacy network across the United Arab Emirates, delivering life-saving therapies and diagnostic lab services.
pharma.detailedOverview: Best Star Pharma Trading L.L.C stands at the vanguard of healthcare delivery in the UAE. Through our strategic acquisition of M/S Ajmal Pharmacy in Sharjah and our landmark equal-stake partnership with Win Path Lab and Health Care in India, we integrate retail pharmacy accessibility, pharmaceutical import-export, and precision pathology diagnostics under one trusted banner.

facility.name: Best Star Facility Management
facility.tagline: Integrated Engineering, Smart HVAC & Building Lifecycle Operations
facility.description: Premier MEP and facility management partner for commercial towers, industrial installations, and institutional complexes across the GCC.
facility.detailedOverview: Best Star Facility Management delivers end-to-end building engineering solutions. We specialize in precision HVAC control systems, complex electrical distributions, automated BMS controls, and comprehensive preventative maintenance programs that maximize operational uptime and slash energy expenditures.

cargo.name: Best Star Cargo
cargo.tagline: Global Air, Sea & Land Freight Forwarding and Supply Chain Logistics
cargo.description: International cargo forwarder offering bonded customs clearance, door-to-door global logistics, and time-critical intermodal transport.
cargo.detailedOverview: Best Star Cargo links the Arabian Gulf to major global trading centers across Europe, Asia, Africa, and the Americas. Leveraging strategic air hubs in Dubai and maritime gateways in Jebel Ali and Sharjah, we ensure frictionless transit of commercial breakbulk, perishable cold cargo, and high-value consignments.

tourism.name: Best Star Tourism L.L.C
tourism.tagline: Exclusive VIP Destination Management & Luxury Travel Curation
tourism.description: The founding vertical of Best Star Group, delivering world-class hospitality, executive corporate travel, and bespoke experiential journeys in the UAE.
tourism.detailedOverview: As the foundational enterprise of the Best Star Group, Best Star Tourism has set benchmark standards in Emirati hospitality for nearly two decades. We cater to high-net-worth individuals, corporate executive delegations, and discerning international leisure travelers seeking unforgettable luxury experiences.

igts.name: IGTS Technical Services L.L.C & Indo Gulf Testing
igts.tagline: Non-Destructive Testing (NDT), Engineering QA/QC & Plant Integrity
igts.description: Accredited inspection and testing laboratory delivering precision engineering verification, weld testing, and industrial safety audits.
igts.detailedOverview: Indo Gulf Inspection & Testing Services (IGTS) LLC and IGTS Technical Services represent our deep commitment to industrial integrity. We support major oil refineries, maritime docks, pipeline networks, and civil infrastructure projects with certified non-destructive testing (NDT), metallurgical evaluations, and structural fitness assessments.

mak.name: MAK Auto Services L.L.C
mak.tagline: Precision Automotive Engineering, Fleet Care & Heavy Diagnostics
mak.description: Cutting-edge automotive maintenance center equipped with German diagnostic computers, bodywork precision bays, and fleet care solutions.
mak.detailedOverview: MAK Auto Services L.L.C operates state-of-the-art automotive engineering hubs serving luxury private vehicles, commercial passenger coaches, and heavy transport fleets. Our expert technicians combine computerized diagnostics with OEM genuine parts to deliver maximum safety and mechanical endurance.

transport.name: Best Star Transport and Leasing L.L.C & Al Saqer
transport.tagline: Commercial Passenger Transit, Luxury Coaches & Fleet Leasing
transport.description: Supplying premier passenger transportation, corporate staff mobility networks, and commercial vehicle leasing to government and private corporations.
transport.detailedOverview: Operating through Best Star Transport and Leasing L.L.C alongside Al Saqer Buses Rental, we command a modern fleet of luxury executive coaches, commuter buses, and specialized passenger vans. We manage reliable daily employee mobility for multinational industrial enterprises, educational institutions, and VIP delegations.

transOcean.name: Trans Ocean International Trading FZE
transOcean.tagline: Global Commodity Trading, Raw Materials & Maritime Logistics
transOcean.description: Multinational commodity trading house connecting high-growth Asian markets with Middle Eastern supply corridors.
transOcean.detailedOverview: Trans Ocean International Trading FZE orchestrates cross-continental commodity trade, focusing on building materials, industrial metals, chemical intermediaries, and fast-moving consumer supplies. Operating out of UAE's premier tax-free international economic zones, we leverage world-class banking and logistics infrastructure to execute high-volume transactions.

power.name: Best Star Power & Infrastructure Projects
power.tagline: High-Voltage Power Grids, Electrical Substations & Urban Electrification
power.description: Execution partner for landmark infrastructure projects including the 380kV/132kV KAFC New Bulk Supply Point in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.
power.detailedOverview: Demonstrating our technical capability in national mega-projects, our engineering division has contributed to critical utility infrastructure in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, including the construction of the landmark KAFC New 380kv/132kv/13.8kv BSP#9020 in King Abdullah Financial City, Riyadh.

aviation.name: Best Star Aviation
aviation.tagline: Private Executive Jet Charters & Aircraft Lease Management
aviation.description: Bespoke executive aviation solutions, private jet brokering, and aerospace logistics serving dignitaries and business leaders worldwide.
aviation.detailedOverview: Best Star Aviation provides discreet, unparalleled private charter and aviation consulting services. Whether arranging intercontinental jet flights for royal delegations or coordinating critical air-cargo charter flights for high-value industrial components, we embody the zenith of luxury and operational precision.

values.title: Corporate Values & Quality Heritage
values.subtitle: At Best Star Group, our Open Innovation Strategy and rigorous HSE protocols empower our partners, protect our global workforce, and drive sustainable growth.
values.hseDesc: Best Star Group maintains zero-accident safety benchmarks across all manufacturing, medical, logistics, and substation engineering sites in accordance with UAE Federal Law No. 8 and OHSAS standards.
values.item1Desc: Entrepreneurial mindset driving strategic diversification into high-growth international markets and technology.
values.item2Desc: Adherence to ISO 9001:2015 frameworks, rigorous QC protocols, and zero-compromise standards in all deliverables.
values.item3Desc: Prioritizing employee health, environmental sustainability, and workplace safety with a zero-accident benchmark.
values.item4Desc: Long-term partnership approach rooted in transparent communication, commercial agility, and proven execution.

csr.title: Empowering Communities: The MAKE Trust & Beyond
csr.subtitle: True enterprise leadership is defined by the lives we uplift. Through our dedicated educational foundation and philanthropic healthcare initiatives, Best Star Group reinvests prosperity into future generations.
csr.item1Desc: Founded by Best Star Group leadership to provide fully funded academic scholarships, technical vocational training, and digital literacy tools to underprivileged students across developing regions.
csr.item2Desc: Through Best Star Pharma Trading and Win Path Lab, we organize recurring free health screening camps, diagnostic pathology tests, and essential medicine distributions for community welfare.
csr.item3Desc: Implementing green HVAC solutions via Best Star Facility Management, transitioning bus transport fleets to low-emission fuels, and eliminating single-use plastics across our corporate facilities.
csr.storyP1: Founded under the auspices of Chairman Ibunu Suwoothu Kamal and the Best Star Group directorate, the MAKE Trust is squarely dedicated to breaking generational poverty through education.
csr.storyP2: The trust provides full higher education scholarships, establishes computer literacy centers in rural schools, and funds vocational engineering training so young women and men can enter high-skilled trades with accredited credentials.
csr.bullet1: Over 1,200 direct academic scholarships distributed to date
csr.bullet2: 14 smart digital classroom installations in rural school systems
csr.bullet3: Free vocational training academies in technical electrical & NDT skills
csr.healthCardDesc: Partnered through Best Star Pharma and Win Path Lab, our medical teams organize free biometric screenings, diabetes diagnostics, and cardiovascular assessments for blue-collar labor communities and industrial workforces across the UAE.

aboutUs.title: About Best Star Group FZE
aboutUs.subtitle: A diversified multinational holding conglomerate operating nine leading enterprises in the United Arab Emirates and pioneering strategic joint ventures across the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, India, and Malaysia.
aboutUs.visionText: To be the GCC premier agile holding company, recognized across our four national hubs for combining commercial speed with unwavering standards of safety, social impact, and zero-defect quality.
aboutUs.missionText: Deploying capital and managerial talent into essential infrastructure, high-touch healthcare, and resilient logistics, building compounding enterprise value while uplifting the communities we serve.
aboutUs.obj1: Expand high-voltage grid infrastructure footprint in Saudi Arabia under Vision 2030 programs.
aboutUs.obj2: Scale specialized retail and institutional pharmaceutical distribution network across UAE emirates.
aboutUs.obj3: Maintain zero-accident safety benchmarks and advance carbon-reduction initiatives across transport fleets.
aboutUs.qualityPolicyDesc: Best Star Group operates under an uncompromising Total Quality Management framework. From pharmaceutical cold-chain integrity to structural testing on oil pipelines, our processes comply with ISO 9001:2015, UAE MOHAP, and ASNT specifications.
aboutUs.hseDesc: Human life and well-being take absolute precedence in every decision we make. Our certified HSE protocols enforce mandatory daily hazard audits, advanced protective equipment, and proactive environmental mitigation across every facility and worksite.
